title: For the past two weeks every single night I live another live in mall world, just found this sub because of it
content: I dream every night vividly of a different life I live that takes place entirely inside a mall. I have friends and family and a place I have set up to live in the mall. every night I go back to this mall like it’s an alternate dimension that I tap into every night for several weeks. I actually really enjoy mall world. Today I finally searched “I dream of living in a mall every night” and found this sub. What do you think is going on? This is absolutely fascinating
